ev.q: The player starts with a sword, and bow and arrow
solving puzzles with available tools is required to complete dungeons
new items and abilities allow access to new areas in previously explored levels
praising its mechanics, simplicity, and difficulty level
It has been called a difficult game, but not punishing or sadistic
collecting souls for the Reaping Commission Headquarters, an office-like bureaucratic afterlife
which can be used to upgrade basic abilities
